CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-convos               /* Main conversation panel */
.zak-ai-convos-header       /* Panel header */
.zak-ai-convos-new          /* New conversation button */
.zak-ai-convos-list         /* Scrollable conversation list */
.zak-ai-convos-group-label  /* Group heading (Today, Yesterday...) */
.zak-ai-convo-item          /* Individual conversation row */
.zak-ai-convo-item.active   /* Currently selected conversation */
.zak-ai-convo-icon          /* Chat icon */
.zak-ai-convo-info          /* Title + preview container */
.zak-ai-convo-title         /* Conversation title */
.zak-ai-convo-preview       /* Last message preview */
.zak-ai-convo-time          /* Timestamp */
.zak-ai-convo-badge         /* Unread indicator dot */
.zak-ai-convos-compact      /* Compact variant */
.zak-ai-convos-inline       /* Horizontal scrollable layout */
